video_title: The Hilarious Story of Joel Embiid's Chick-fil-A order

quotes.speaker: Yaron Weitzman
quotes.summary_phrase: The origin of the Sixers' rookie Chick-fil-A tradition
quotes.excerpt: Sixers rookies before the team takes a flight, they stop by the Chick-fil-A

text_blocks.speaker: Yaron Weitzman
text_blocks.text: There was a long-held tradition among Sixers players in the Sixers locker room that Sixers rookies before the team takes a flight, they stop by the Chick-fil-A and they pick up stuff and bring it to the players on the flight. Joel Embiid turned out to have a huge order.

text_blocks.speaker: Landry Shamet
text_blocks.text: I don't really know why or how they signed on to this, but I pitched the Sixers on, 'Hey, can I do a ride-along with him for the Chick-fil-A order?'

quotes.speaker: Yaron Weitzman
quotes.summary_phrase: The specific details of Joel Embiid's massive Chick-fil-A order
quotes.excerpt: Four chicken sandwiches, four milkshakes, four fries, four sodas
quotes.quote: A separate order, this needs to be in a separate bag. Four chicken sandwiches, four milkshakes, four fries, four sodas, I believe. We can confirm if I got that order right. It was like Moses Malone, four, four, four, four. It needs to be a separate bag. That's Joel's order and he said, 'Yeah, it's from Bubbs.' That was the security guard slash Joel Embiid body guy.

quotes.speaker: Yaron Weitzman
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's reaction to the viral Chick-fil-A story
quotes.excerpt: Joel Embiid was very angry and furious. And to this day, I think he's still annoyed
quotes.quote: We put that story out, it went viral, and Joel Embiid was very angry and furious. And to this day, I think he's still annoyed with me about it. He was asked about it a few times. Zach Lowe asked him about it on the podcast. I read it off, I think from my book, and Joel said it was an exaggeration or was a joke or wasn't really for him. I forget the excuse.
